subject.title: Bug: Cron fallback chain broken — models return zero-token success or killed by shared AbortController

question: Is there fresh current-main or post-https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100483 release evidence that either the abort-deadline symptom or the cron session model-persistence symptom still fails?
rationale: The empty-result classifier root cause is fixed on main, but source alone does not prove whether the remaining symptoms are current bugs or expected outer-deadline/sticky-fallback behavior.

options.title: Keep open for current repro
options.body: Ask for configured outer timeout, model-attempt timestamps, abort reason/time, and resulting session model fields before queueing another repair.

options.title: Close after shipped classifier fix
options.body: Close only if maintainers accept that the outer deadline behavior is intentional and no current session-persistence evidence appears after the fix ships.

options.title: Adopt the budget PR direction
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/52365 or a replacement only after its proof and stop-semantics blockers are resolved.

recommendation.title: Keep open for current repro
recommendation.body: Ask for configured outer timeout, model-attempt timestamps, abort reason/time, and resulting session model fields before queueing another repair.

likelyOwner.reason: He landed the partial fix and already framed the remaining evidence needed on the issue.
